description: WHAT-IF optimises linked water, hydropower, agriculture and electricity investments and operations. Its repository supplies a generic synthetic example and distinct maintained study branches for the Zambezi and Nile contexts. The provider is WHAT-IF authors. Coverage: The model uses sub-basins and monthly water balances with power-demand segments. Geography, planning horizons and input vintages depend on the selected case. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository states GPL version 3 for the model. Solver and source-data terms are separate. Limitations: The optimisation assumes perfect foresight across the planning horizon. Legacy branch data may need adaptation for newer model versions. For simulation it supports investment and policy comparisons across water-energy-food systems. Related resources: P01130 is the Zambezi application of this reusable model, not a duplicate model record.
